shared_or_similar_visual_information: A shaded region with an adjacent unshaded interior cutout or excluded part. On the left, use the blue region inside the circle and outside the white triangle. On the right, use the light-blue center of the square bordered by four unshaded corner sectors.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The fill selects the disk with the inscribed triangular part excluded. Right image: It selects the center remaining after removing the four corner sectors from the square.
Rationales: The shade identifies the remainder after leaving designated pieces out of an enclosing geometric area. Those pieces must be removed from the area computation in each panel.
